model: Six-round Gaston in the existing Ascon-AEAD128-style research mode; (IV,K0,K1,N0,N1), first two output words observable

strict_degree_conclusions.64D_cube_key_recovery_via_feature_matchi: No information: cube sum is independent of every key bit.
strict_degree_conclusions.63D_matrix_key_linear_part: Total-degree-64 component; IV and round constants do not affect it.

first_round_structure.meaning: First round is not affine on this cube. Rank concerns first-round mixed coefficients only, not the final superpoly.

four_factor_method_transfer.prefix_boundary: Z=L(S4), before fifth-round chi; every Z bit has total degree at most 16.
four_factor_method_transfer.key_linear_coefficient_rule: For [N^I k_j] with |I|=63, distribute the 63 nonce variables disjointly as 15+16+16+16 among four prefix factors; the size-15 factor supplies k_j.
four_factor_method_transfer.why_no_all_key_matching_needed: The resulting superpoly is affine in the full key; solve a linear system instead of evaluating a nonlinear feature table on 2^128 keys.
four_factor_method_transfer.scope: Formal counts only. Not counts of nonzero full-cube coefficients, not a completed MILP screen, and not the cost basis for the rotation-interpolation schedule.

rotation_identity: For I={1,...,63} in N0: A_(a,j)=ROL_j B_(a,-j mod 64), where B_(a,t)=XOR_(N0[t]=0) (H(K_a=1,N0)+H(K=0,N0)), H=(Q o L)^6.
coefficient_extraction: B for both representative key bits is computed in one 2^64-point stream; each point evaluates H at key 0 and the two representatives.

streaming_transform.record: Full sum plus one zero-fixed facet sum per processed coordinate.
streaming_transform.merge: (a_full,a_facets),(b_full,b_facets) -> (a_full XOR b_full, a_facets XOR b_facets, a_full)
streaming_transform.memory_excludes: Language object overhead; bound is for a packed implementation, not NumPy demo arrays.

full_size_cost_schedule_not_executed.candidate_space: Exactly 2^(128-rho) keys satisfy the affine cube equations; rho=rank(A).
full_size_cost_schedule_not_executed.verification_upper_bound: O(2^(128-rho)) full-key checks on known observations.

limitations: The six-round 128x128 coefficient matrix has not been evaluated and its rank is unknown.
2^66 is a proved evaluation schedule for obtaining equations and online cube sums, not an unconditional full-key recovery claim.
Reduced-word matrix ranks do not prove anything about the actual six-round rank.
A 64-bit feature observes at most 64 independent equations in 128 key bits; this differs from the previous Hsilu local-key feature.
The schedule uses total-degree truncation and rotation, not a completed Gaston division-property/MILP quartic screen.
No literature novelty claim is made for the symmetry-based interpolation schedule.
